questions.question: All employees are requested to submit ______ travel expense reports by Friday.
questions.explanation: 此处需要形容词性物主代词修饰名词短语 travel expense reports。

questions.question: The marketing director emphasized the need for ______ market research before launching the product.
questions.explanation: 此处需要形容词修饰名词 market research。

questions.question: Mr. Harrison will take over the project manager position ______ Ms. Vance retires next month.
questions.explanation: 引导时间状语从句，表示“当……时候”，用连词 when。

questions.question: The new software update significantly ______ the loading speed of our customer database.
questions.explanation: 句意为主动语态一般现在时，主语为单数第三人称，谓语动词用 improves。

questions.question: Clients who wish to cancel their subscription must notify customer service at ______ thirty days in advance.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 at least 表示“至少”。

questions.question: To ensure timely delivery, please verify that your shipping address is entered ______.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 entered，需用副词 more correctly 表示程度最高。

questions.question: The board of directors agreed to allocate additional funds ______ the research and development department.
questions.explanation: allocate sth. to sb./sth. 为固定搭配，表示“分配给……”。

questions.question: Attendance at the annual safety seminar is mandatory ______ all factory floor workers.
questions.explanation: mandatory for sb. 表示“对某人是强制性的”。

questions.question: The marketing director emphasized ______ market research before launching the product.
questions.explanation: 此处需要形容词修饰名词 market research，表示 emphasis on research quality。

questions.question: Mr. Harrison will take over the project manager position ______ Ms. Vance retires next month.
questions.explanation: Harrison 将在 Ms. Vance 退休之前接任该职位，用 before。

questions.question: The company’s chief executive officer will deliver a keynote speech ______ the opening ceremony.
questions.explanation: deliver a speech in the opening ceremony 表示“在开幕式上发表”，用 in。

questions.question: Factory workers must wear protective gear at all times ______ entering the assembly zone.
questions.explanation: at all times during entering 表示“进入过程中随时”，符合语义。

questions.question: Please review the attached contract carefully and sign it ______ you return it to our legal department.
questions.explanation: 在退回法律部之前先完成签名，用 before。

questions.question: The accounting department reported that third-quarter revenues exceeded initial ______.
questions.explanation: exceed projected figures 是常见企业用语，表示‘超过预计值’。

questions.question: To improve client satisfaction, our support team responds to all inquiries ______ 24 hours.
questions.explanation: responds within 24 hours 表示‘在 24 小时之内答复’。

questions.question: Mr. Jenkins has consistently demonstrated ______ leadership skills throughout his tenure.
questions.explanation: demonstrated exceptionally 表示‘表现非常出色地’，副词作宾补与副词。

questions.question: All visitors are required to register at the front desk ______ receiving a security badge.
questions.explanation: upon receiving 为固定结构，意为‘一收到……便’。

questions.question: The human resources manager will ______ candidates for the vacant administrative assistant position.
questions.explanation: will be interviewed by the HR manager，此处用被动语态，interviewed 为过去分词。

questions.question: Sales figures for the new tablet model have been ______ higher than expected this quarter.
questions.explanation: have been considerably higher 是正确的被动加比较级结构。

questions.question: Employees who complete the online training module will receive a certificate ______ completion.
questions.explanation: certificate in completion 表示‘结业证书’，in 为常用介词。

questions.question: The maintenance crew will inspect the elevator system ______ the weekend to minimize disruption.
questions.explanation: since the weekend 表示‘自本周末起’，引导时间状语。

questions.question: Our firm offers comprehensive consulting services tailored to the ______ needs of small businesses.
questions.explanation: tailored to the specific needs 表示‘专门定制服务’，修饰 needs。

questions.question: Please submit your completed application forms ______ Monday afternoon to be considered for the grant.
questions.explanation: submit by Monday afternoon 表示‘在周一下午之前提交’，by 为准确表达。

questions.question: The newly hired accountant manages financial records ______ and accurately.
questions.explanation: with efficiently and accurately 并列副词，表示‘高效且准确地’，more efficiently 程度更强。

questions.question: To access the secure company intranet, employees must enter ______ assigned credentials.
questions.explanation: enter their assigned credentials，形容词性物主代词修饰名词。

questions.question: The management team decided to postpone the expansion plans ______ unfavorable economic conditions.
questions.explanation: postpone plans due to conditions，due to 后接名词，表示‘由于’。

questions.question: Ms. Tanaka was promoted to senior accountant ______ her exceptional performance over the past year.
questions.explanation: promoted to senior accountant despite performance，although 引导让步状语。

questions.question: The new printing machine operates much ______ than the previous model.
questions.explanation: much quieter than 为固定比较结构，形容词比较级修饰 operates。

questions.question: We are seeking a candidate with proven experience in ______ international logistics and supply chains.
questions.explanation: in managing 为介词加动名词结构，experience in doing sth.。

questions.question: The conference training session will cover ______ effective communication techniques in the workplace.
questions.explanation: several 修饰可数名词复数 techniques（许多个）。

questions.question: All invoices must be approved by the department head ______ being processed for payment.
questions.explanation: before being processed 表示‘在付款处理前核准’。

questions.question: The chief financial officer presented a detailed report ______ the company's annual budget.
questions.explanation: presented a report to the board about budget，这里 report to sb. 固定搭配。

questions.question: Our customer support representatives are available to assist you ______ any technical difficulties.
questions.explanation: assist you with difficulties，with 为常用介词。

questions.question: The conference room has been reserved ______ the morning executive meeting.
questions.explanation: reserved at 10am，表示时间地点，用 at。

questions.question: Staff members are encouraged to share their feedback ______ the new office layout.
questions.explanation: feedback regarding layout，regarding 为介词。

questions.question: To maintain high quality standards, each product undergoes rigorous testing ______ shipment.
questions.explanation: testing before shipment，表示‘发货前’，before 符合时间顺序。

questions.question: Ms. Roberts has been ______ for managing the upcoming international trade exhibition.
questions.explanation: has been responsible for，表示‘负责’，固定搭配。

questions.question: The security system automatically locks all main doors ______ the building closes at 10 PM.
questions.explanation: when 引导时间状语从句，表示‘当建筑关闭时’。

questions.question: Clients who require technical assistance are advised to contact our help desk ______.
questions.explanation: contact help desk directly，direct 作副词修饰动词 contact。
